THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
CREDITS & IMAGE INDEX
103
Source & edition notes
Reference photography is supplied by the editor. Individual photographer and rights-holder details
were not provided; source filenames are retained in the accompanying CSV and Obsidian archive.
81 study images use AI-enhanced editions; studies 18 and 44 retain the original references.
Enhancements can change details and image dimensions. These are not exact 2× reproductions.
The complete original reference set, four cover references, searchable prompts and CSV image index
are preserved in the Obsidian companion. Prompts describe new, original adult subjects; they are
distinct from the identity-preserving enhancement workflow.
THE PORTRAIT EDIT / ISSUE 01 / THE FASHION ISSUE October 2026
